_comment: WITHHOLD-ERA ATTRIBUTION arm (SPEC_withhold_era_release 8.5 step 1).
Knob-verbatim clone of _fld63_relevel4h_on.json -- the certified ON leg whose 29-epoch
A4 era and subsequent fleet re-level the therapy premise rests on -- with ONLY the
product output path redirected, so the reference run's artifacts are not overwritten
(the 8b overwrite trap).  No new knob: the leveling-carry retirement census is
always-on counters with no CSV row and no solve effect, so this run is byte-identical
to the reference ON leg on every solve artifact given the same exe.
*** NOTE the exe DIFFERS from the reference: this build is POST the carrier-phase
wind-up SIGN fix (4f49fa2 + 0d25aa0), which is documented solve-affecting on field
data.  So this is NOT a byte-cert of the reference; it is a fresh measurement of what
the same CONFIG does on the current binary. ***
PRE-REGISTERED reading of the four families at the era's end:
(1) the TIMER model predicts a single-epoch [B] n_cr_inject_stale near the carried
fleet, spanning MANY stations, with [A] departures small -- the carry is bypassed, not
erased.  (2) If instead [C] quality refloats dominate, the 'cliff was therapy' premise
gets its first actual support.  (3) If [A] carries the mass, the arcs genuinely
departed and neither reading holds.  (4) If NO era recurs at all on this binary (as on
the ctlw control, which showed 20- and 7-epoch eras and ZERO fleet expiry), the fixture
no longer reproduces the event and the successor card needs a new repro before any
mechanism is designed.
